members.name: Elin Andersson
members.bio: Elin writes about health systems, equity and the people who work to change them. She can be reached at editor@thedeterminant.se.

members.name: Oskar Lindqvist
members.bio: Oskar covers governance, health financing and the politics of global health. He believes every health student should read a budget.

members.name: Maja Karlsson
members.bio: Maja tracks regional health policy in Västra Götaland and national developments in Swedish healthcare.

members.name: Amara Okafor
members.bio: Amara focuses on antimicrobial resistance, epidemiology and translating academic research for a student audience.

members.name: Felix Strand
members.bio: Felix interviews alumni and reports on career pathways in international health organisations.

members.name: Mei Tanaka
members.bio: Mei covers student life at Medicinareberget, from housing and integration to the annual gala.
